caption: The drawing depicts a man and a pig positioned atop a large knife. The pig is colored in light brown and is walking forward with a rope around its neck. The pig is located on the broad, grey blade of the knife. The man, who wears dark clothing with a black jacket, light grey pants, and a dark hat with a small grey feather, stands on the handle of the knife, which is colored a rusty red-brown with beige ends. The man is holding one end of the rope in his left hand, which connects to the pig, and in his right hand, he holds a stick or whip raised upwards. The background is plain and uncolored. There are some small swatches of color in the lower right corner, including shades of brown, orange, and black. The entire drawing is done in muted and earthy tones.
title: Sign
